text: Performed in the evening (Pradosha, at starry dusk) on Ashvayuja Shukla Dashami
The Pandavas hid their weapons in a Shami tree during their year in hiding. Worship the tree; if you cannot reach one, chant these verses.
Shami takes away sin and destroys enemies. She guarded Arjuna's bow and is dear to Rama.
Shami has eyes like lotus petals and carries thorns. May Lakshmi rest on her, who gives people long life.
Salutations to the tree of trust that held Arjuna's weapons. I take a leaf from you — always give me victory.
She calms all that is inauspicious, removes wrong deeds and bad dreams. I take refuge in the blessed, auspicious Shami.
